title: Base Defense Battle
description: Fortify your command outpost against wave after wave of armored invaders—place turrets, call airstrikes, and upgrade firepower to keep the base standing.
controls: Tap build slots to place and upgrade defense turrets, and trigger special support skills during boss waves.

zh-CN.title: 基地保卫战
zh-CN.description: 热血策略塔防基地保卫战：部署重机枪炮塔与导弹阵列，灵活升级火力防线，抵御一波波装甲敌军猛烈进攻！
zh-CN.controls: 点击空位部署并升级防御炮塔，关键时刻释放强力支援技能守住基地防线。
